title: Confusion of 'ly'
theory:
 There are some words that appear to be adverbs because they end in "ly", but they actually
 function as adjectives.
 Cowardly Scholarly Deadly Lively Monthly
 Niggardly Friendly Costly Manly Princely
 Miserly Lovely Timely Womanly Masterly
 Elderly Heavenly Leisurely Weekly Worldly
 Holy Comely Godly Kingly Motherly
 Fatherly Yearly

 Note
 Noun + ly = Adjective
 Adjective + ly = Adverb

 Note
  Coward (Noun) + ly = Cowardly (Adjective)
  Love (Noun) + ly = Lovely (Adjective)
  Niggard (Noun) + ly = Niggardly (Adjective)
  Friend (Noun) + ly = Friendly (Adjective)
  Scholar (Noun) + ly = Scholarly (Adjective)

 Note
 yearly, weekly and monthly are used as both adjective and adverb.
